loopmath needs a command, one of:
  analyze, validate-prices, prices, graph, adapt, verify-receipts, task-types, workflows, recommend,

cli/loopmath --help.stdout:
usage: loopmath [-h] [--version]
                {analyze,validate-prices,prices,graph,adapt,verify-receipts,task-types,workflows,recommend,run,outcome,budget,config,fit,onboard,share,prior,runs,posterior,status,report,doctor,guide,update,skill,ocp,check-change,screen,builder,gate,tasks,harness} ...

loopmath: which agent workflow to run next, priced from your own logs

positional arguments:
  {analyze,validate-prices,prices,graph,adapt,verify-receipts,task-types,workflows,recommend,run,outcome,budget,config,fit,onboard,share,prior,runs,posterior,status,report,doctor,guide,update,skill,ocp,check-change,screen,builder,gate,tasks,harness}
    analyze             cost per accepted run from your local harness logs
    validate-prices     check a price table's schema, staleness and todo flags
    prices              show the active price table
    graph               emit the workflow graph of one or more workspaces
    adapt               emit OCP v0.2 from an ADE store (experimental;
                        loopmath ocp migrate converts it to v0.3), or import
                        runs
    verify-receipts     check that the receipts in your store are whole and
                        scored right (or give a research ledger file)
    task-types          list task types and task features
    workflows           catalog and user workflows: list, show, validate, diff
    recommend           choices for one task (options 1 to 5) with chance and
                        cost, the success-cost curve
    run                 record a run: start, record, import, attempt,
                        artifact, finish, sessions
    outcome             record a verdict, score, late event or pair preference
    budget              spend against the cap; set the cap
    config              get or set configuration
    fit                 refit the belief from the prior bundle and your runs
    onboard             turn your Claude Code and Codex history into runs and
                        a first fit
    share               write the shareable part of your store to a file
    prior               the shipped prior bundle: show, import-shared, remove-
                        shared
    runs                previous runs (table, one run, HTML page)
    posterior           current estimates by level and by workflow graph
    status              fit age, open runs, spend, store health
    report              receipt calibration and exploration outcomes
    doctor              check logs, store, fit, prices and skill
    guide               print the instructions for one job (onboard, import,
                        plan, record, fit) or the command reference, for an
                        agent to follow; read only
    update              is a newer loopmath out? the installed and latest
                        versions and the upgrade command; never upgrades
    skill               install, remove or print the loopmath skill
    ocp                 validate or migrate OCP documents
    check-change        paired A/B check of a change: start, status, from-runs
    screen              experimental: fold-over screen of harness edits:
                        start, next, status, apply
    builder             build your own workflow on a local page and see its
                        estimates change
    gate                experimental: adopt or reject a harness change:
                        compare base and candidate runs
    tasks               experimental: score a candidate on fewer tasks: the
                        next task, an estimate, stop or continue
    harness             experimental: tune a Claude Code harness: init, plan,
                        run, watch, show, apply

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
